title: Runtime-Incremental Transformer for Reinforcement-Learning-Based Adaptive Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.13545v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning-based adaptive control of robotic manipulators with non-observable friction memory has been addressed by attention- based meta-controllers whose number of attention heads is fixed before training and is tuned by costly offline search. At long memory horizons, such fixed-capacity controllers are prone to catastrophic failures on a sizeable fraction of training seeds. The present paper introduces a runtime mechanism that grows and prunes the heads of the attention block during reinforcement learning, governed by two signals: the effective rank of the on-policy context distribution, which triggers growth when representational capacity becomes insufficient, and the per-head output magnitude, which flags redundant heads for removal. Policy continuity at growth events and a quantitative bound at prune events are established analytically. translated_title: 面向强化学习自适应控制的运行时增量式Transformer
translated_abstract: 针对具有不可观测摩擦记忆的机器人机械臂的基于学习的自适应控制问题，现有方法采用基于注意力的元控制器，其注意力头数量在训练前固定，且需要通过代价高昂的离线搜索进行调节。在较长的记忆时域下，这种固定容量的控制器容易在相当一部分训练随机种子上发生灾难性失败。本文提出了一种运行时机制，能够在强化学习过程中对注意力块的头进行增长与修剪，该机制由两个信号控制：在线策略上下文分布的有效秩——当表征容量不足时触发头增长；以及每个注意力头的输出幅值——用于标记冗余头并将其移除。论文从分析角度建立了增长事件时的策略连续性保证以及修剪事件时的定量界限。在一个带有Stribeck摩擦的二连杆机械臂上，所提出的机制实现了完全成功（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种在强化学习训练过程中根据上下文分布有效秩和注意力头输出幅值这两个信号动态增长与修剪注意力头的运行时机制，解决了固定容量注意力元控制器在长记忆时域下易发生灾难性失败的问题，并给出了增长与修剪时的策略连续性和定量界限分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a runtime mechanism that grows and prunes transformer attention heads during reinforcement learning—driven by the effective rank of the on-policy context distribution and per-head output magnitudes—resolving catastrophic failures of fixed-capacity attention-based meta-controllers under long memory horizons, with analytic guarantees of policy continuity at growth events and quantitative bounds at prune events.
